name: The List of Everyone
objective: The Registry Hall keeps a second book: every keeper of uncounted lights, going back two centuries. The clerk does not want it read.
intro: The reading room smells of lamp oil and old paper. The clerk stands in front of one specific shelf, arms folded.
dialogue: Registry Clerk: "You are not on the list. I keep the list. Do you see the problem?"
Registry Clerk (defeated): "...You have been added to the list. Welcome, I suppose."
lore_discovery: The second book lists the keepers — and shows the current Lamplighter checked in, alive, 'below'. The key to the well winch is pressed between its pages.
